documentation.file_docstring:
Declarative policy schema for Agent-OS governance.

Defines PolicyDocument and related models that represent policies as
pure data (JSON/YAML) rather than coupling structure with evaluation logic.
member_docstrings: PolicyOperator: Comparison operators for policy conditions.
PolicyAction: Actions a policy rule can prescribe.
PolicyCondition: A single condition evaluated against execution context.
PolicyRule: A single governance rule within a policy document.
PolicyDefaults: Default settings applied when no rule matches.
from_yaml: Load a PolicyDocument from a YAML file.
to_yaml: Serialize this PolicyDocument to a YAML file.
from_json: Load a PolicyDocument from a JSON file.
to_json: Serialize this PolicyDocument to a JSON file.
